inlines.v: INTERWE'AVE, verb transitive preterit tense interwove; participle passive interwoven. [inter and weave.] 1. To weave together; to intermix or unite in texture or construction; as threads of silk and cotton interwoven. 2. To intermix; to set among or together; as a covert of interwoven trees. 3. To intermingle; to insert together; as, to interweave truth with falsehood.
